text: Half reps? That's cheating! You won't build a single muscle unless you go full range!
Full range is great. But are half reps really useless?
On leg extensions, one group did full reps. Another did only the bottom half, where the quads are stretched.
The stretched half-reps grew the quads as much as full reps, and in some spots, more.
Full reps are still great. Just never skip the stretched bottom part. Save this.
